title: Contempt; authority to punish; punishment.
bodyText:
(a) With respect to any proceeding under this chapter:

(1) A military judge detailed to a court-martial or any other proceeding under this chapter;

(2) Any military magistrate designated to preside under section 124B-46; or

(3) The president of a court of inquiry,

may punish for contempt any person who conducts themselves in violation of section 710-1077.

(b) The punishment for contempt under subsection (a) shall be the same as the punishments permitted under civilian criminal contempt of court laws and rules.

(c) A punishment imposed under this section:

(1) If imposed by a military judge or military magistrate, may be reviewed in the same manner as review from the circuit courts of the State; and

(2) If imposed by a court of inquiry, shall be subject to review by the convening authority in accordance with rules adopted by the governor or adjutant general, or as provided by law.
